# Generated by /ases-scaffold Step B (Sonnet) — Docker Compose for full local stack.
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: jayanth_db
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: ${DB_NAME}
      POSTGRES_USER: ${DB_USER}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ./backend/db/bootstrap.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/01_bootstrap.sql:ro
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${DB_USER} -d ${DB_NAME}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  backend:
    build: ./backend
    container_name: jayanth_backend
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+psycopg://${DB_USER}:${DB_PASSWORD}@db:5432/${DB_NAME}
      APP_ENV: ${APP_ENV:-development}
      APP_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      APP_PORT: 8000
      APP_CORS_ORIGINS: http://localhost:3000
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-INFO}
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - ./backend:/app
      - backend_venv:/app/.venv

  frontend:
    build: ./frontend
    container_name: jayanth_frontend
    depends_on:
      - backend
    environment:
      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    volumes:
      - ./frontend:/app
      - frontend_node_modules:/app/node_modules

volumes:
  pgdata:
  backend_venv:
  frontend_node_modules:

[project]
name = "jayanth-trading-backend"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Jayanth Trading Tiles System — FastAPI backend"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
readme = "README.md"

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
addopts = "-ra -q --strict-markers"
markers = [
  "unit: unit tests (no DB)",
  "integration: integration tests (real DB)",
  "system: end-to-end system tests",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B", "UP"]
ignore = ["E501"]

# Alembic configuration — Jayanth Trading Tiles
[alembic]
script_location = db/migrations
prepend_sys_path = .
version_path_separator = os
sqlalchemy.url = postgresql+psycopg://trading_app:CHANGEME@localhost:5432/jayanth_trading
# Note: at runtime env.py overrides sqlalchemy.url with the DATABASE_URL env var.

[post_write_hooks]

[loggers]
keys = root,sqlalchemy,alembic

[handlers]
keys = console

[formatters]
keys = generic

[logger_root]
level = WARN
handlers = console
qualname =

[logger_sqlalchemy]
level = WARN
handlers =
qualname = sqlalchemy.engine

[logger_alembic]
level = INFO
handlers =
qualname = alembic

[handler_console]
class = StreamHandler
args = (sys.stderr,)
level = NOTSET
formatter = generic

[formatter_generic]
format = %(levelname)-5.5s [%(name)s] %(message)s
datefmt = %H:%M:%S

# Backend — Jayanth Trading Tiles System

FastAPI 0.115 + SQLAlchemy 2.0 + PostgreSQL 16.

## Layout
- `src/` — application package (created per task in S1)
- `db/bootstrap.sql` — Postgres init (extensions + grants)
- `db/migrations/` — Alembic migrations (initialized in S1)
- `tests/{unit,integration,system}/` — pytest suites

## Run via Docker (recommended)
From project root:

    cp .env.example .env       # fill DB_PASSWORD
    docker-compose up -d db
    docker-compose up backend

## Run via venv (local IDE workflow)

    python -m venv .venv
    .venv\Scripts\activate     # Windows
    pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
    cp .env.example .env
    uvicorn src.main:app --reload

The actual `src/main.py` is created in S1; until then `import src.main` will fail.

B.1.label: Database Bootstrap (Docker mode)
B.1.instruction: SKIP the standard B.1 manual psql flow. bootstrap.sql is mounted by docker-compose. PO must copy .env.example to .env and set DB_PASSWORD before continuing. To verify, the PO will later run `docker-compose up -d db` and confirm `docker logs jayanth_db` shows '01_bootstrap.sql' completed cleanly.

B.2.label: Backend venv + pip install (Windows host)
B.2.notes: Venv is for local IDE/IntelliSense. Production runtime uses the Docker image. Use Windows-style venv path (Scripts/python.exe) since the host is Windows 10.

B.3.label: Database Connection Verify
B.3.instruction: Only runnable AFTER PO has (1) created backend/.env from backend/.env.example with a real DB_PASSWORD, and (2) `docker-compose up -d db` is running (or local postgres is bootstrapped). If either pre-condition is missing, STOP and instruct PO. Otherwise:
commands: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import os; from dotenv import load_dotenv; load_dotenv('backend/.env'); import psycopg; psycopg.connect(os.environ['DATABASE_URL']).close(); print('db_ok')"

B.4.label: Frontend npm install + shadcn init
commands: cd frontend && npx shadcn@latest init --yes --base-color slate --css-variables
cd frontend && npx shadcn@latest add button card dialog input label select table popover calendar form checkbox badge separator skeleton sonner --yes

verify_cmd: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import fastapi, sqlalchemy, psycopg, alembic, pydantic; print('backend_deps_ok')" && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
post_scaffold_notes: Sprint 1's first task plan will (a) run `alembic init backend/db/migrations` to create env.py + script.py.mako, (b) write SQLAlchemy models for all 13 tables, (c) generate the baseline migration, (d) write the seed script.
Backend src/ stays mostly empty after scaffold — main.py, config.py, db.py all land in S1 per-task plans.
Frontend src/ will be populated by /ases-ui-scaffold in S1 after /ases-ui-design + /ases-ui-review.
